Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Subject: Hiring of Machinery (JCBs, Tippers and Tractors) along with Manpower for Snow-Clear ance Operations in Municipal Council Pulwama during Winter Season 2026–27. Contract Period: 15.11.2026 to 31.03.2027. 1. Scope of Work Municipal Council Pulwama invites online bids through the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) for hiring of machinery, namely JCBs, Tippers and Tractors, along with manpower for undertaking snow-clearance opera tions within the municipal limits of Pulwama during Winter Season 2026–27, for the period commencing fro m 15.11.2026 to 31.03.2027. The machinery and manpower shall be deployed strictly on an as-and-when-required basis, depending upon snowfall, weather conditions, field requirements and directions of the authorised officer of the Munici pal Council. The requirement of machinery and manpower shall be as under: S. No. Description Quantity 1. JCB Excavator/Backhoe Loader 02 Nos. 2. Tipper for lifting and transportation of snow 02 Nos. 3. Tractor fitted with Snow Blade/Leveller 02 Nos. 4. Manpower for manual snow clearance and allied field operations 15 Persons The scope of work shall include clearance of snow from roads, lanes, by-lanes, footpaths, drains, approach es to essential public services and other identified public places, besides lifting and transportation of accu mulated snow wherever required. The manpower shall undertake manual snow clearance at locations inac cessible to machinery and other allied field operations as directed by the Municipal Council. 2. Terms and Conditions 1. The successful bidder/agency shall provide the required machinery and manpower strictly on an as- and-when-required basis, upon requisition by the Municipal Council during the contract period.

2. The Municipal Council shall have the discretion to requisition all or any of the machinery and manpo wer, depending upon the intensity of snowfall and actual field requirements. No minimum deployme nt, working hours, working days or payment shall be guaranteed to the successful bidder. 3. The successful bidder shall ensure the availability of all six machinery units, along with the required operators/drivers and up to 15 manpower personnel, whenever requisitioned by the authorised offic er of the Municipal Council, including during night hours, holidays and emergency situations. 4. The agency shall ensure timely deployment of the required machinery and manpower at the design ated locations within the time specified by the Municipal Council after receipt of requisition/deploym ent instructions. 5. All machinery shall be in good working condition, roadworthy and suitable for snow-clearance operat ions. JCBs shall be equipped with appropriate buckets, while tractors shall be fitted with suitable sno w blades/levellers for effective snow clearance. 6. The agency shall provide competent and experienced operators/drivers for operating the respective machinery. All expenses relating to their wages, remuneration and other employment-related liabilities shall be borne by the successful bidder. 7. The rates quoted for machinery shall be inclusive of all expenses, including POL (petrol/diesel), lubri cants, operator/driver charges, maintenance, repairs, transportation, applicable taxes and other inci dental expenses. No additional charges shall be payable by the Municipal Council on any account. 8. The agency shall be responsible for regular maintenance and upkeep of the machinery. In case of an y breakdown or mechanical failure, the agency shall immediately arrange for repair or replacement of the machinery without any additional financial liability to the Municipal Council. 9. The agency shall ensure that the machinery remains operational throughout the contract period and shall not withdraw any machinery without prior permission of the authorised officer of the Municipal Council. 10. The agency shall provide up to 15 manpower personnel for manual snow clearance and allied field o perations, as and when required by the Municipal Council. The manpower shall be deployed at the lo cations and in the numbers specified by the authorised officer. 11. The manpower shall undertake manual removal of snow from lanes, by-lanes, footpaths, drains, app roaches to public institutions and other locations inaccessible to machinery or identified by the Muni cipal Council. 12. The manpower shall be engaged and paid at the Government-approved rate of ₹311/- (Rupees Th ree Hundred Eleven only) per person per day, subject to actual deployment and attendance d uly verified by the authorised municipal officer. No payment shall be admissible for any person or w orking day during which the manpower has not actually been deployed. 13. The agency shall ensure that the deployed manpower is physically fit for the assigned duties and is provided with necessary protective clothing, gloves, footwear and other safety equipment required for snow-clearance operations. 14. The agency shall remain responsible for the proper conduct, discipline and safety of its deployed ma npower and operators/drivers. All personnel shall follow the instructions of the authorised municipal officer and comply with applicable safety requirements. 15. The agency shall be solely responsible for payment of wages/remuneration to the deployed manpow er at the prescribed Government-approved rate of ₹311/- per person per day and for compliance wit h applicable labour laws and statutory obligations. 16. The agency shall be responsible for any accident, injury, damage to public or private property or oth er liability arising out of negligence or improper operation of machinery or conduct of its deployed p ersonnel during execution of the work. 17. Proper deployment records/logbooks shall be maintained by the agency indicating the date, locatio n, machinery deployed, commencement and completion timings and actual working hours. Similarly, attendance records of manpower shall be maintained on a daily basis. All such records sh all be verified and certified by the designated municipal officer. 18. Payment for machinery shall be made strictly on the basis of actual working hours duly authorised,

verified and certified by the competent/designated municipal officer at the accepted contractual rat es. 19. Payment towards manpower shall be restricted to the actual number of persons deployed and worki ng days duly verified and certified by the authorised municipal officer, at the Government-approved rate of ₹311/- per person per day, subject to applicable statutory provisions and financial formalities . 20. No payment shall be admissible for idle hours, unauthorised deployment, unverified working hours, absentee manpower or any machinery/personnel not actually utilised for the assigned work. 21. The Municipal Council shall not be liable to guarantee minimum working hours, daily deployment, c ontinuous engagement or minimum payment to the successful bidder. The agency shall not be entit led to claim any compensation on account of non-deployment or lesser deployment due to insufficie nt snowfall, change in weather conditions or any other operational requirement. 22. Failure to provide the required machinery or manpower within the stipulated time, repeated breakd owns, unauthorised withdrawal of machinery/personnel, absenteeism or unsatisfactory performance shall render the agency liable to proportionate deductions, penalties or other appropriate contractu al action in accordance with the published GeM bid conditions and applicable rules. 23. The successful bidder shall not sublet or transfer the contract, wholly or partly, to any other agency/ person without prior written approval of the competent authority. 24. The Municipal Council reserves the right to terminate the contract in case of persistent non-perform ance, violation of contractual conditions or any other valid reason, in accordance with applicable rul es and contractual provisions. 3. Financial Bid / Rate Quotation The bidders shall quote separate rates for each category of machinery in the prescribed GeM financial bid, as per the following units: S. N Description Unit of Quotation o. 1. JCB Excavator/Backhoe Loader Per working hour 2. Tipper Per working hour, per vehicle 3. Tractor fitted with Snow Blade/Leveller Per working hour, per vehicle Manpower for manual snow clearance and allied Per person per day (Government-approved ra 4. field operations te: ₹311/-) The manpower shall be deployed strictly as per actual requirement, subject to a maximum of 15 persons, and payment shall be made only for actual working days duly verified and certified by the authorised officer. The rates quoted for machinery shall be inclusive of all applicable operational expenses, including POL, op erators/drivers, maintenance and repairs. No additional financial liability shall be created upon the Municip al Council beyond the accepted contractual rates and admissible manpower payments. 4. Documents to be Submitted by the Bidder The bidder shall upload the following documents along with the bid, wherever applicable and as prescribed under GeM: 1. PAN Card of the bidder/firm. 2. GST Registration Certificate, wherever applicable. 3. Registration/constitution details of the firm or agency. 4. Details and ownership/valid possession documents of the machinery proposed to be deployed. 5. Undertaking confirming the availability of 02 JCBs, 02 Tippers and 02 Tractors throughout the contra ct period. 6. Undertaking confirming the availability of up to 15 manpower personnel for manual snow clearance

and allied field operations, as and when required. 7. Undertaking confirming payment of manpower wages at the Government-approved rate of ₹311/- p er person per day. 8. Undertaking confirming that all machinery shall be maintained in good working condition and deplo yed immediately upon requisition. 9. Acceptance of all terms and conditions of the bid. 10. Any other document specifically required under the published GeM bid. 5. General Conditions The successful bidder shall execute the work strictly in accordance with the instructions of the Municipal C ouncil and the terms and conditions stipulated in the GeM bid. The Municipal Council reserves the right to r egulate the deployment of machinery and manpower according to actual snowfall conditions, operational p riorities and public safety requirements. The competent authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids, wholly or partly, in accordan ce with applicable rules and GeM provisions, without assigning any reason thereof. .
